Symbols.Label: Toggle object detection per camera. Uses server variables for runtime control.
1. Cameras use Hikvision HTTP snapshot URLs: http://admin:***@TVCC{N}/Streaming/channels/1/picture
2. When YOLO is enabled, each frame is processed through a YOLOv8 ONNX model for object detection.
3. Detection results (Label, Confidence, Count, Alive) are written to OPC server variables.
4. The YoloEnableVariable lets you toggle detection ON/OFF at runtime via a Boolean variable.
5. Bounding boxes are drawn directly on the MJPEG stream when DrawDetections is enabled.
• Entrance (TVCC1): HTTP snapshot, YOLO enabled, dynamic enable via variable.
• Warehouse (TVCC2): HTTP snapshot, YOLO enabled, confidence 0.40.
• Parking (TVCC3): HTTP snapshot at 2 FPS, YOLO off by default (toggle to enable).
💡 Toggle the switches above to enable/disable YOLO per camera at runtime!
